damage_mechanism: Valve and rod packing damage, lube oil breakdown
response: Cut load, check the aftercooler fans and fins

damage_mechanism: Overpressure toward the PSV set pressure (30 barg)
response: Choke back the Pad 12 wells, restore compression or flare

damage_mechanism: Crosshead and foundation bolt loosening, bearing wear
response: Reduce load, inspect frame bolts and crosshead clearances

damage_mechanism: Glycol thermal degradation above 204 degC; poor lean glycol purity below 190 degC
response: Check burner and fuel gas; raise stripping gas; sample lean glycol

damage_mechanism: MDEA degradation and reboiler corrosion above 127 degC; poor stripping below 115 degC
response: Adjust hot oil to the reboiler; check lean amine loading

damage_mechanism: Sales gas hydrocarbon dew point off specification
response: Check propane compressor E1-K-5004 and chiller level

damage_mechanism: Sales gas off specification (2.0 mol% CO2)
response: Raise amine circulation; check for foaming

damage_mechanism: Sales gas off specification; hydrates in the propane chiller
response: Check TEG reboiler temperature and circulation; raise methanol to E1-E-5001
